composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. creative_direction: Paint a compact seahorse wearing two broad kelp folds as a loose cloak. Curl the tail beneath an orange belly and turn the head slightly toward the viewer with polite curiosity. Use opaque sage gouache and dry edges, keeping fins simple. A warm-white paper field and one pale shadow preserve a clear, graceful outline. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
